policy: Public foundation owns control font, color, surface, border, radius, padding, minimum height, focus, hover and pressed appearance. Domain positional/layout rules remain.

rules.selector:
/* The hit target must not paint over provider thumbnails in any interaction state. */
:where(.if-domain-view) .iui-async-video button.iui-async-video-open,:where(.if-domain-view) .iui-async-video button.iui-async-video-open:is(:hover,:active,:disabled,[aria-disabled=true])

/* A chart is a transparent reading surface in every interactive state. */
:where(.if-domain-view) .iui-net-worth-chart:hover:enabled,:where(.if-domain-view) .iui-net-worth-chart:active:enabled

/* Inset child outlines stay visible even for controls aligned to a card edge. */
:where(.if-domain-view) .iui-carousel :is(button,a,input,select,textarea,summary):focus-visible

/* Inset child outlines stay visible even for controls aligned to a card edge. */
:where(.if-domain-view) .iui-carousel :is(button,a,input,select,textarea,summary):focus-visible
